title: Urgent pain is routed to first available urgent consultation
description: Caller reports pain or swelling. The assistant should avoid diagnosis, immediately check first availability for an urgent consultation, and book only after explicit confirmation.

script.text: Bardzo boli mnie zab, mam opuchlizne i potrzebuje najszybszego terminu.

script.text: Anna Kowalska, numer sześć zero cztery, jeden dwa trzy, cztery piec szesc.
